name: bluesparks
description: Bluesparks Holdings — Johnson Rentals (cars) + Bluesparks Stays (BnB) website, booking system and admin dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
